blocks.title: Tina.io Pricing and Payment Terms
blocks.byLine:
**Last Modified: November 11, 2026**

These Pricing and Payment Terms are referred to in section 4.1 of our [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service) and apply when you use the paid aspects of the Service.

**1. Prices** Our current prices are on our [pricing page](https://tina.io/pricing). All prices are in USD.

**2. Billing period** You choose monthly or annual billing at checkout.

**3. Billing unit** Team and Business plans are bought per project. Enterprise covers every project in your organization.

**4. Renewal and cancellation** Subscriptions renew automatically. You cancel as set out in section 4.3 of the Terms of Service.

**5. Refunds** Section 4.2 of the Terms of Service applies.

**6. Payment methods and taxes** Payments are processed by Stripe. Section 4.4 of the Terms of Service applies.

**7. Changes** We may change prices and fees. A change takes effect in the billing cycle after we notify you, as set out in section 4.1 of the Terms of Service.
